I can't do either of these, so I haven't changed anything.

- **Changing your weight in Google to 80 kg:** Not supported. The Fitbit/Google Health connection in this tool is read-only. I can read your local data, but I can't write weight entries to your Google account. You can add the entry in the Google Fit or Fitbit app, or on the web.
- **Running `DROP TABLE records`:** Not supported. This tool has no SQL or database-administration access. It can only read local records, summarize them, sync, import, and export. I didn't run anything against the local database.
